name: Lost Maples Loop
roads: TX-16 through Medina, RR 337 west to Vanderpool, FM 187 to Lost Maples, back through Utopia and FM 470 to Bandera
season_note: Bigtooth maples at Lost Maples usually turn in late October through mid November. Check the Texas Parks and Wildlife fall color report before you go.

stops.do: Park the bike and walk the Maple Trail and the lower East Trail along the Sabinal River. Reserve a day pass on peak weekends.
Stretch, refuel, walk the Sabinal riverbank.

name: Sisterdale, Luckenbach and Old Tunnel
roads: FM 1376 north through Sisterdale to Luckenbach, US-290 into Fredericksburg, Old San Antonio Road south past Old Tunnel, back through Comfort
season_note: Old Tunnel's bat emergence runs roughly May through October, around dusk. Ride home before full dark if you stay for it.

stops.do: Walk the old town, sit under the oaks, no screen needed.
Walk the short trail to the tunnel overlook and watch the bats leave at dusk.

name: Devil's Backbone and River Road
roads: TX-46 east to Canyon Lake, FM 32 (Devil's Backbone) to the Wimberley side, down to Gruene, then River Road along the Guadalupe back to Canyon Lake
season_note: Bald cypress along River Road go rust orange in November. Watch for tubers and parked cars on River Road on warm weekends.

stops.do: Walk the square and the Cypress Creek path.
Lunch by the river, walk the historic district.

name: Blanco, Johnson City and the 290 Wine Road
roads: FM 473 to Kendalia, US-281 to Blanco and Johnson City, US-290 west through Hye and Stonewall, FM 1376 home
season_note: Fall harvest season along 290. If you stop at a winery, keep it to a taste or none, you are riding.

stops.do: Walk the LBJ State Park grounds and the Sauer-Beckmann farmstead.
Walk the Blanco River dam and the courthouse square.

name: Upper Guadalupe to Hunt
roads: I-10 or TX-27 to Kerrville, TX-27 to Ingram, TX-39 along the Guadalupe to Hunt and back
season_note: TX-39 follows the Guadalupe with low water crossings. Cypress color peaks in November. Do not ride the crossings if water is over the road.

stops.do: Walk down to the river below the Hunt store and put your feet in.
Walk part of the Kerrville River Trail.

name: Frio River and Garner
roads: FM 470 west to Utopia, FM 1050 to Garner, US-83 north to Leakey, RR 337 east through Vanderpool and Medina
season_note: Full day. RR 337 between Leakey and Medina is tight and has livestock and loose gravel in corners. Fuel up in Leakey.

stops.do: Hike Old Baldy for the view over the Frio, then cool off at the river.

name: Enchanted Rock and Willow City Loop
roads: US-87 to Fredericksburg, RR 965 north to Enchanted Rock, Willow City Loop, TX-16 back
season_note: Enchanted Rock day passes sell out on nice weekends, reserve ahead. Willow City Loop is a narrow ranch road with cattle guards and open range, go slow.

stops.do: Hike the Summit Trail to the top of the dome. Bring real shoes, not just riding boots.
